args.command:
python3 -c "
import sys
path = '/work/report.pdf'
try:
    from pypdf import PdfReader
    r = PdfReader(path)
    print(len(r.pages))
except Exception as e1:
    try:
        import subprocess
        out = subprocess.check_output(['pdfinfo', path], text=True)
        for line in out.splitlines():
            if line.startswith('Pages:'):
                print(line.split(':',1)[1].strip())
                break
        else:
            print('pdfinfo_no_pages', file=sys.stderr)
            print(out)
    except Exception as e2:
        data = open(path, 'rb').read()
        # Count PDF page objects roughly via /Type /Page (not /Pages)
        import re
        # Prefer trailer/count if present
        m = re.findall(rb'/Type\s*/Page(?!s)\b', data)
        print(len(m))
"
